method:
Count physical Rust diff lines by crate at immutable Git revisions.

No rename detection: moving code between files counts as removal + addition.
Inline cfg(test) items and files reached through test-only modules are tests.
Cargo manifests/lockfiles, docs, generated fixtures and Web are not Rust lines.
limitations: Physical lines include whitespace and comments in their owning section; not SLOC
Mixed production/test files are split at cfg(test) item boundaries; benches and test_support are test infrastructure
Rust examples and build.rs count as production; Cargo metadata is excluded
No feature execution is implied; module reachability is a source classification
